reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering mussel stones, a legendary fish, mystery and mystic items, a combat ring, nautilus remains, minerals, oak resin, and obsidian were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary and fish names, gameplay effects, mineral terminology, object gender, fossil context, and descriptive imagery; both found no remaining objective issue.

MutantCarp_Description.source: The strange waters of the sewer turned this carp into a monstrosity.
MutantCarp_Description.translation: Apele ciudate ale canalizării au transformat acest crap într-o monstruozitate.

MysteryBox_Description.source: A blacksmith can open this for you. Who knows what might be inside?
MysteryBox_Description.translation: Un fierar ți-o poate deschide. Cine știe ce s-ar putea afla înăuntru?

MysticStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
MysticStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține piatră, minereuri sau geode.

MysticSyrup_Description.source: A very rare syrup that is said to have magic properties.
MysticSyrup_Description.translation: Un sirop foarte rar despre care se spune că are proprietăți magice.

MysticTreeSeed_Description.source: This can be planted to grow a special tree.
MysticTreeSeed_Description.translation: Poate fi plantată pentru a crește un copac deosebit.

NapalmRing_Description.source: When you defeat an enemy, they explode.
NapalmRing_Description.translation: Când învingi un inamic, acesta explodează.

NautilusFossil_Description.source: This must've washed up ages ago from an ancient coral reef.
NautilusFossil_Description.translation: Trebuie să fi fost adusă la mal cu mult timp în urmă, de pe un recif străvechi de corali.

Nekoite_Description.source: The delicate shards form a tiny pink meadow.
Nekoite_Description.translation: Cioburile delicate formează o pajiște roz în miniatură.

Neptunite_Description.source: A jet-black crystal that is unusually reflective.
Neptunite_Description.translation: Un cristal negru ca tăciunele, care reflectă neobișnuit de bine lumina.

OakResin_Description.source: A sticky, fragrant substance derived from oak sap.
OakResin_Description.translation: O substanță lipicioasă și parfumată, obținută din seva stejarului.

Obsidian_Name.preservationReason: Obsidian is the standard Romanian mineral name with the same spelling as the English source.

Obsidian_Description.source: A volcanic glass that forms when lava cools rapidly.
Obsidian_Description.translation: O sticlă vulcanică formată când lava se răcește rapid.
